name: flags
title: Feature flags
description: OpenFeature feature flags for Lunora — declare a `defineFlags` provider in lunora/flags.ts and codegen wires `ctx.flags` onto every query, mutation, and action context. Ships with an in-memory provider; swap to Cloudflare Flagship for production.
docs: After installing, run `lunora codegen` — codegen discovers the `defineFlags()` call in lunora/flags.ts and wires `ctx.flags` onto every context. Add more flags to the `memoryProvider` as you develop; when ready for production, provision a Cloudflare Flagship account, add a `FLAGS` binding to wrangler.jsonc, and swap the provider to `flagshipProvider({ binding: "FLAGS" })`.
